This returns one provider response with no portable pagination; keep the predicate selective and do not use it for a full export. Use returned IDs with `get-record`.

functions.name: search-records
functions.description: Find one page of records using a saved search, an ad hoc query, or both, with selectable return fields.

limit.description: Records per page, default 50 and maximum 100; never requests all records.

query.description: Unencoded Agiloft ad hoc expression, such as summary~='test'&&priority='High'. Supports =, !=, ~=, <, <=, >, >=, && and ||; null designates empty fields. Not SQL.

table.description: Logical table to search.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation scoped to the connection and identical criteria, fields and limit; omit for the first page.

fieldNames.description: Additional logical fields to return. Omit for provider identity/type/ownership defaults; id is always included.

items.description: Logical field name.

savedSearchLabel.description: Exact saved-search label from list-saved-searches; if query is also present it further restricts the saved search.

FunctionInput_agiloft_cc_searchrecords.description: Criteria, return fields and continuation for one record search page.

table.description: Logical searched table.

items.description: One returned value, or null for an empty value.

additionalProperties.description: Returned text, an empty field, or explicitly returned multiple values.

fields.description: Decoded returned field values excluding id. Missing remains absent, empty is null, proven multi-values are arrays. Timezone-less date/time text retains local meaning.

items.description: A matching record with decoded field values.
One page of matching records in provider order, or an empty array.

nextCursor.description: Opaque next-page continuation; omitted after established exhaustion. Another page can be empty.

FunctionOutput_agiloft_cc_searchrecords.description: One ordered search page and an optional continuation, without a global total.

KB.description: Knowledgebase name used by this connection.

lang.description: Two-letter connection language; defaults to en.

tags.instructions: Use `list-saved-searches` for saved-search labels and `get-table` for logical field names. Supply ordinary query text, not URL-encoded text. A saved search and query can be combined to narrow results. Pass nextCursor back with identical criteria, fields and limit. Use `list-records` for browsing without criteria or `search-record-ids` for database-level SQL ID selection.

functions.name: update-record
functions.description: Modify supplied fields of one record selected by ID or a unique SQL predicate, optionally overriding its lock, and return its updated fields.

table.description: Logical table containing the record.

anyOf.description: Literal field text, preserving local date/time meaning.

items.description: One assigned multi-value.

anyOf.description: Replacement multi-values; an empty array requests clearing.

value.description: Literal imported-column example value; integration escapes lookup delimiters.

where.description: Alternative donor-table SQL predicate using database column names, without WHERE.

sourceTable.description: Donor table name, needed for a multi-donor link.

items.description: Exactly one literal example or donor-table SQL lookup, with an optional donor table.

links.description: Linked-record example or SQL lookups replacing the assigned field's linked values.

additionalProperties.description: A scalar, clearing request, replacement multi-values, or linked-record lookups.

fields.description: Partial assignments keyed by logical field name. Omitted fields are unchanged. Null clears; empty array clears multi-values; empty string is explicit text subject to provider empty normalization. Multi-values replace that supplied field's values.

ignoreLock.description: Intentionally bypass the record lock using NOLOCK. Does not grant permissions or unlock the record.

recordId.description: Opaque table-scoped record ID; alternative to matchWhere.

matchWhere.description: SQL predicate using database column names that must identify exactly one record; alternative to recordId, without WHERE keyword.

FunctionInput_agiloft_cc_updaterecord.description: Partial assignments for one record selected by exactly one ID or unique SQL predicate.

id.description: Opaque ID of the updated record.

table.description: Logical table used for the update.

items.description: One decoded multi-value or empty value.

additionalProperties.description: Decoded scalar or multi-value field contents.

fields.description: Final decoded record fields excluding id, including provider-calculated values. Empty is null; absent stays absent. Date/time text without timezone retains local meaning.

FunctionOutput_agiloft_cc_updaterecord.description: Final contents returned by the native update, including calculated fields.

language.description: Connection language; defaults to en when absent.

tags.instructions: Get the ID from `search-records` or use a unique SQL predicate. Inspect `get-table` before assigning custom fields. Omitted fields are unchanged; null requests clearing. Set ignoreLock only when intentionally overriding a lock and authorized to do so. This can trigger configured record rules; do not assume repeating it is harmless. Use `upsert-record` only if a missing match should create a record.

functions.name: upload-attachment
functions.description: Upload one file to an attachment field on an existing record and return the field's resulting attachment count.

field.description: Logical attachment or image field to receive the file.

table.description: Case-sensitive logical table name in the connected KB.

fileName.description: File name to assign, including its extension when applicable; Unicode is preserved.

recordId.description: Opaque decimal ID of the existing record receiving the file.

contentType.description: Media type of the file bytes, such as application/pdf or text/plain; used for the upload's file content.

contentBase64.description: Standard padded base64 of the exact file bytes, at most 1,048,576 decoded bytes. Empty means a zero-byte file, not an omitted upload.

FunctionInput_agiloft_cc_uploadattachmen.description: Destination record field and one base64-encoded file to upload.

attachmentCount.description: Total number of files in this record field reported after the upload; not the uploaded file's position.

FunctionOutput_agiloft_cc_uploadattachme.description: Provider-reported total attachment count after the upload.

knowledgebase.description: Case-sensitive connected Agiloft knowledgebase name, sent as $KB.

language.description: Agiloft request language, sent as $lang, such as en.

tags.instructions: Use for one file of at most 1 MiB. You need the logical table, record ID, and attachment field. Use `list-attachments` afterward to obtain current file positions for `download-attachment` or `remove-attachment`. Uploading may be constrained by the field's subtype, extension, and file settings. Do not blindly repeat an upload after an ambiguous result.

functions.name: upsert-record
functions.description: Create a record when business matching criteria find no record, or partially update the one matching record; reject multiple matches.

table.description: Logical destination table; matching is evaluated within this table and connection KB.

anyOf.description: An explicit field value, including an empty string; local date/time strings are passed through unchanged.

items.description: One value assigned to the multi-value field.

anyOf.description: Values assigned to a multi-value field; an empty array requests clearing.

where.description: Alternative donor-table SQL predicate using database column names, without WHERE.

sourceTable.description: Donor table name, needed for links with multiple donor tables.

items.description: One linked-record lookup using either a literal example or a donor-table predicate, but not both.

links.description: Linked-record lookups for the assigned field, serialized internally.

anyOf.description: Structured linked-record assignments for one field.

additionalProperties.description: A string, null to request empty, a string array, or structured linked-record lookups.

fields.description: Fields to populate on create or modify on update, keyed by logical name. Include the business key explicitly. Omitted fields are unchanged on update or use creation defaults; null requests empty, [] clears multi-values, and empty string is sent explicitly.

matchQuery.description: Unencoded Agiloft matching expression, such as external_id='SF-001234' or company_name='Acme'&&contract_type='NDA'. Zero matches creates, one updates, multiple matches fail.

FunctionInput_agiloft_cc_upsertrecord.description: Destination table, native business matching criteria, and explicit partial-write fields.

id.description: Opaque ID of the created or updated record.

table.description: Logical destination table.

action.description: Whether the native operation created a new record or updated its single match, based on the documented response status.

FunctionOutput_agiloft_cc_upsertrecord.description: Completed synchronous upsert result, identifying the record and the native create or update branch.

knowledgebase.description: Case-sensitive connection knowledgebase name used as $KB.

language.description: Configured Agiloft field-name language; omitted or null uses en.

tags.instructions: Use this for external-system synchronization with a stable unique business key. Inspect fields with `get-table`. Include required creation values and the match-key value in fields: the matching expression does not populate new fields for you. Use `update-record` when absence should be an error, or `create-record` when a new record is always intended. Do not assume concurrent upserts or replay are duplicate-proof.
